ठ: ठ 1. ठ, the twelfth consonant and aspi-rate of the preceding letter. —ठ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ठ्. —ठकारय (fr. the last), nom. P. ठकारयति: Desid. टिठकारयिषति।

ठ 2. ठ, अस्, m. a loud noise; an imitative sound as of a golden pitcher rolling down steps; the disk of the sun or moon, a circle, a globe; a cypher; a place frequented or held sacred by all; an object of sense; an idol, a deity; an epithet of Śiva.
ठक्कन: ठक्कन ठक्कन, अस्, m., N. of a prince; (various readings have ढक्कन and थक्कन।)
ठक्कुर: ठक्कुर ठक्कुर, अस्, m. an idol, a deity, an object of reverence or worship; an honorific title after the name of a distinguished person; (sometimes written Thākur or popularly Tagore.)
ठठम्: ठठम् ठठम्, ind. an imitative sound. See 2. ठ।
ठार: ठार ठार, अस्, m. rime, hoar-frost.
ठिण्ठा: ठिण्ठा ठिण्ठा, f., N. of a woman.
